why: Team C loses its own hue and renders as the white fallback -- the state that shipped between issue #281's descriptor landing and TEAM_COLORS gaining a third entry. It is not a crash and not a blank: `teamColor` still returns a colour, the ring still draws, the shell still tints, the tread trail still blends, and the stock chip still paints. What is lost is that a 2v1v1 match renders one whole SIDE in the fallback white, which the player has no way to read as a team. Deliberately mutated to `0xffffff` -- the actual fallback -- rather than to a duplicate of team A or B: a duplicate is caught by the pairwise-distinctness sweep, which makes that the easy half, while the fallback is a DISTINCT colour and passes every distinctness assertion. It is caught instead by the stock-readout case that asserts team 2's chip is TEAM_COLORS[2] and is not the fallback, which is the one place the two are told apart. Scoped to entities.test.ts and hud.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
